title: Deadly Predicament in the Secret Chamber
next_chapter_hook: The ancient teleportation array's patterns began to glow with a ghostly blue light, and a majestic spatial power enveloped the two—however, when the light faded, the scene before their eyes made Chen Ji's face change abruptly.

text.content: Collapsing rocks crashed down behind them, the rising dust choking them nearly unable to open their eyes. Chen Ji covered his mouth and nose with one hand, his other hand gripping Ye Qing's wrist tightly as he stumbled forward through the flying ash. The familiar and sinister aura behind them was like a bone-anchored disease, drawing closer and closer.

dialogue.content: "How are they so fast?" Ye Qing's voice came through the wind, carrying uncontrollable astonishment, "I clearly used the mist to conceal our presence..."

text.content: "The Holy Sect's tracking techniques are not to be trifled with." Chen Ji's voice was calm as always, but a cold glint flickered in his eyes, "Besides... they've come with every intention of succeeding." Before he could finish, the end of the corridor ahead suddenly collapsed, revealing a dark and deep fissure. Without hesitation, he pulled Ye Qing around the waist and leaped into the darkness.

dialogue.content: "You're insane!" Ye Qing cried out, her hands unconsciously gripping Chen Ji's robe tightly. The howling wind of the fall rushed into her ears, and she could feel his heartbeat from his chest—the rhythm was even steadier than her own.

text.content: The two fell into pitch darkness, and after a moment came the dull sound of heavy objects landing. The expected excruciating pain did not come—Chen Ji had used his own body as a cushion, catching Ye Qing at the cost of his own body. His back slammed against the cold stone wall, a groan escaping his lips, yet a faint smile curved his lips: "Lucky. Didn't die from the fall."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing struggled to climb off him. In the darkness, her expression was invisible, but the irritation in her voice was evident: "You... idiot! Who told you to catch me?!" Her hand reached out and pressed against Chen Ji's back, her fingertips touching something wet—that was blood.

text.content: "Minor wound." Chen Ji pressed her hand down, preventing her from examining further, "Compared to being captured by the Holy Sect, what's this cost?" He looked around the area. In the darkness, he could vaguely make out this was a small stone chamber. The air carried a stale smell, as if it had been sealed for ages.

dialogue.content: "You always do this..." Ye Qing's voice softened, carrying an imperceptible tremor, "You know everything, you've calculated everything, yet at the most critical moment, you gamble with your own life. What exactly are you after?"

text.content: A light laugh came from the darkness. The笑意 carried a hint of self-mockery and relief: "What am I after?" His voice suddenly softened, as if asking her, or perhaps asking himself, "Perhaps... I just don't want to be alone anymore." After saying this, he himself was stunned for a moment, as if he hadn't expected to say such words.

dialogue.content: The stone chamber was so quiet that one could hear each other's breathing. After a long while, Ye Qing's voice finally sounded again, as light as if afraid to disturb something: "...Me too." Three words, spoken extremely lightly, yet weighing like a thousand catties.

choice.prompt: In this dark chamber where life and death were intertwined, Chen Ji decided...

choices.description: Since the words had already been spoken, he might as well confess the loneliness and calculations he had suppressed for years, letting Ye Qing see his true self
choices.visible_reward: The relationship with Ye Qing has broken through to "Life-and-Death Comrades"
choices.risk_hint: Once the heart is laid bare, there is no going back

dialogue.content: "Since childhood, no one has cared whether I lived or died." Chen Ji's voice was平静得近乎冷漠, as if narrating someone else's story, "From the moment the Tianji Record chose me, I knew I could only live a life of calculations. But you're different... You're the first person willing to stand on the cliff's edge with me."

text.content: In the darkness, a hand gently clasped his. The touch was slightly cool, yet it stirred an unprecedented warmth in his heart.

choices.description: Using his usual rogue attitude to cover up the emotional moment just now, to avoid the atmosphere being too heavy and raising suspicion
choices.visible_cost: Missing the Opportunity for Deeper Communication
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining the废物 persona to avoid exposing his inner self

dialogue.content: "Ai, don't make it so sentimental." Chen Ji brushed the dust off his clothes, his tone recovering some of his careless demeanor, "I'm a person with cheap life, a few falls won't kill me. As for you, the little princess of the Holy Sect, stuck here with this pauper—don't嫌弃 me."
Ye Qing's hand withdrew. Her voice carried a subtle sense of loss: "...Indeed. You are always like this."

text.content: Just then, the fragment at Chen Ji's brow center grew faintly warm. His pupils constricted sharply—the Tianji Record had actually detected a faint spiritual pattern fluctuation in this chamber! He rose abruptly, following that faint induction to grope forward. His fingertips touched a groove.

dialogue.content: "There's something strange here." He lowered his voice, slowly infusing a thread of spiritual energy through his palm. Deep within the groove, ghostly blue light suddenly blazed, illuminating the mottled ancient patterns on the entire wall—it was actually a teleportation array! And although the array was incomplete, it was still perfectly preserved.

text.content: "Ancient teleportation array!" Ye Qing gasped, quickly walking to Chen Ji's side. She gazed at those ancient patterns that had endured years of erosion yet still circulated with faint light, "How could such an ancient relic appear beneath Tianqing Sect..." She looked up suddenly, "Could it be that Tianqing Sect's establishment itself is related to this teleportation array?"

choice.prompt: Facing this ancient teleportation array fragment, Chen Ji must make a decision...

choices.description: Holy Sect pursuers could find them here at any moment. Must evacuate first before they react, even if the destination is unknown
choices.risk_hint: The teleportation array's destination is unclear, possibly a deadly ground

text.content: "There's no time to hesitate." A flash of determination crossed Chen Ji's eyes. His hands abruptly pressed onto the array's core. The ghostly blue light suddenly surged, and a majestic spatial power surged from the array, enveloping the two. "Hold onto me!" he shouted, turning to grip Ye Qing's wrist. The light devoured all vision, and alongside the howling wind came piercing white brilliance—

choices.text: First Use the Tianji Record for Divination
choices.description: The Tianji Record can foresee the next three hours. First see clearly where the teleportation array will send them, then decide
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate points are extremely precious, and divination results may be blurred by Chen Nian

text.content: "Wait." Chen Ji pressed Ye Qing's hand, closing his eyes. The fragment at his brow center vibrated intensely, and a familiar dizziness came over him—he saw the blurry scene again: after the light faded, there was a desolate ruin, but deep within the ruin, something important seemed to be hidden...

choices.description: Ancient arrays must have profound mysteries. Taking time to decipher might find a safer activation method or additional gains
choices.visible_reward: Might Obtain Ancient Array Knowledge or Hidden Mechanisms
choices.risk_hint: Pursuers are approaching, may not have time to decipher

dialogue.content: "Not so fast." Chen Ji crouched down, carefully examining the ancient inscriptions on the array's edge. His brow furrowed tighter and tighter, "These inscriptions... are Dao patterns used by ancient immortal sects. If I remember correctly, such arrays usually have triple insurance—activation, control, and safety barriers. If we can find the control center..."

text.content: Before he could finish, a deafening roar came from outside the chamber—the pursuers had broken through a passage!

dialogue.content: "They're here!" Ye Qing's voice tensed abruptly. Dark mist gathered in her hands, ready to fight at any moment, "Chen Ji, what do we do?" Her gaze fell on the teleportation array, then turned to Chen Ji, awaiting his decision.

text.content: Chen Ji stood up, placing Ye Qing behind him. A familiar cold smile curved his lips: "Good timing." His voice was low, audible only to the two of them, "I want to see what kind of trash the Holy Sect sent this time." Despite his words, his hand had already quietly gripped Ye Qing's—a posture of protection, and also a promise to live or die together.

dialogue.content: "You're injured. Let me—" Just as Ye Qing was about to step forward, Chen Ji yanked her back. "How long can your mist last?" His voice was terrifyingly calm, "Save it. This one is mine."

choice.prompt: Heavy footsteps echoed at the chamber entrance. Chen Ji had to make the final choice...

choices.description: Since retreat is impossible, might as well set an ambush here and catch the pursuers off guard
choices.visible_cost: Trading Injuries for Injuries, Consequences Uncertain
choices.visible_reward: Might heavily wound the Holy Sect pursuers and capture intelligence
choices.risk_hint: The enemy is many while we are few, and we don't know their strength

dialogue.content: "Want to capture me?" Chen Ji coldly laughed as he took several talismans from his sleeve, "Let's see if they have the ability!" A fierce glint flashed in his eyes, "Ye Qing, when the time comes, I'll hold them off. You go first through the teleportation array."
"Dream on!" Ye Qing's reply was resolute, "If we die, we die together!"

choices.description: Immediately infuse spiritual energy into the array's core, gamble that this ancient teleportation array can carry the two to escape

text.content: "Go!" Chen Ji hesitated no longer. He pulled Ye Qing into the array with one hand, both hands pressing onto the activation nodes simultaneously. Ghostly blue light surged intensely, almost simultaneously with the sound of pursuers rushing into the chamber—the teleportation array shuddered violently, and spatial power swallowed the two. In the chaos, Chen Ji only managed to catch sight of several black shadows lunging forward, and the next moment, his vision was completely covered by white light.

choices.description: Use the chamber's terrain and Ye Qing's mist to create chaos, seize the opportunity to find other escape routes

dialogue.content: "Ye Qing, the mist!" Chen Ji shouted lowly. At the same time, he pulled out a handful of gravel from his chest and precisely threw it toward the acoustic dead spots around the chamber. The sounds became chaotic, and the pursuers' footsteps immediately hesitated. "Follow me!" He dragged Ye Qing around to the other side of the chamber, and indeed discovered faint light behind a pile of rubble—it was a hidden door concealed by vines!

text.content: No matter which path was chosen, the teleportation array's light had already lit beneath their feet. Spatial power surged like a tide, gradually etherealizing their forms. Ye Qing tightly held Chen Ji's hand. Her voice was torn apart by the howling wind yet remained clearly audible: "No matter where we go... I won't regret." Chen Ji didn't answer, only gripped that hand even tighter.

The ancient teleportation array's patterns began to glow with a ghostly blue light, and a majestic spatial power enveloped the two—however, when the light faded, the scene before their eyes made Chen Ji's face change abruptly. It was a desolate ruin. Among the broken walls and debris, an aura of death pervaded. And deep within the ruins, a stone gate exactly resembling the Tianji Record fragment in his arms was emanating a cold, eerie glow.
